title: Flint on Windows
summary: The first Flint build for Windows, plus artwork for every version.
points: Flint Client now runs on Windows 10 and 11
Each Minecraft version has its own artwork in the version picker, Home and Profiles
Auto Sync saves settings correctly on Windows
Safer handling of file paths in Minecraft version data

title: Beta 1 is here
summary: The first Flint beta for Minecraft 26.3.
points: Quick Play: pin up to five servers from Multiplayer to the main menu
Flint updates itself: an Update button appears when a new version is out
A clearer Settings button, and the Store coming soon
Flint's main menu stays readable at any GUI scale

title: Flint, now inside Minecraft
summary: Flint's own menu, now in Minecraft 26.3.
points: A Flint main menu inside Minecraft 26.3 with Fabric
Discord Rich Presence for games launched from Flint
Flint AI finds mods, resource packs and shaders in the Library
Memory can be set for each profile

title: A calmer, more complete Flint
summary: Home, Profiles and Skins rebuilt around real account and profile data.
points: Home, Profiles and Skins rebuilt around real account and profile data
Library talks to Modrinth with a live catalog, dependencies and a performance preset
Apple silicon marks 1.8.9 unsupported instead of failing mid-download
Safer RAM limits and a wired AI gateway with keyword fallback

title: A new Flint
summary: Guided first-run setup with Microsoft sign-in.
points: Guided first-run setup with Microsoft sign-in
Profiles with real Minecraft and Fabric installs
Mod suggestions checked against Modrinth
New Home, Settings and themes
